primary_finding.status: software/ only contains a pure C11 host-side CAN codec/session/TTL and a host test; no buildable G431/HAL, FOC loop, ADC/angle conversion, CAN driver, PWM actuation, current limiting, fault-to-break logic, or telemetry transmitter was found.

motor_phase_and_iq_current.seller_current_semantics: unknown: bus or phase, measurement point, RMS or peak, continuous or peak, duration and thermal conditions are unspecified; it is not a validated phase-current or Iq limit.
motor_phase_and_iq_current.reason: No motor R/L or calibrated current transform is available; protocol defines Iq as signed q-axis current, not battery current or torque. The host codec only serializes a signed cA field.

candidate_model_only.classification: reference-model candidate only; no MCU implementation or hardware guarantee; 120 A is not a motor rating or absolute hardware maximum

analog_protection_candidate.classification: schematic/threshold corner estimates only; no guaranteed fast clamp below 120 A; drift, ripple, propagation, break-to-gate delay, overshoot, and parasitics remain open

bus_current_and_power.classification: selection/screening condition, not a continuous or peak board capability and not implemented firmware power limiting
bus_current_and_power.600_W_value: sensitivity only; not a capability or approved limit
bus_current_and_power.bms_current_and_power_budget: provided independently by BMS; no qualified value established by this FOC software audit

bus_voltage.classification: candidate analog circuit values, not verified runtime protection; SAFE_5V loss can disable the dump path; 100 V component ratings are not a bus voltage limit

regeneration.model_policy: In this one-direction reference path, the model treats requested Iq < 0 as regen for the purpose of checking fresh, qualified per-board allocated sink power; unknown, zero, stale, or unqualified budget blocks that modeled request.
regeneration.classification: single-direction sensitivity/reference result only; command expiry zeros the reference but not physical current or returned energy; do not infer real regen solely from negative Iq
regeneration.four_quadrant_caveat: This sign shortcut is not a universal four-quadrant mapping: real regeneration depends on signed mechanical/electrical power. Negative Iq during reverse rotation can be motoring, so a real controller must qualify regen from torque/current and speed/power direction.

temperature_and_faults.candidate_fault_architecture: positive phase-current comparator to G431 COMP/TIM1 Break; negative phase-current external comparator to BKIN; SAFE undervoltage COMP4-to-Break; bus overvoltage comparator/dump; fault latch and explicit re-ARM requirements
temperature_and_faults.status: not target-firmware implemented or bench verified; fault routing/register configuration, timing, thermal behavior, dump energy path, and shutdown/re-isolation remain open

speed.protocol_signal: signed target motor shaft mechanical RPM request
speed.protocol_field: int16 except 0x8000 sentinel; field range is serialization range, not a safety speed limit
speed.seller_speed_note_scope: series range with unspecified conditions; not verified for this 270 KV unit
speed.classification: no validated maximum RPM or speed clamp found
